records.title: LexSumm and LexT5: Benchmarking and Modeling Legal Summarization Tasks in English
records.reason: LexSumm and LexT5 provide a legal summarization benchmark/model and evaluate task quality and faithfulness; no inference-efficiency mechanism is reported.

records.title: ChainBuddy: An AI-assisted Agent System for Generating LLM Pipelines
records.reason: ChainBuddy studies an assistant for creating/evaluating LLM pipelines through a user study; its outcome is workflow usability and pipeline quality, not runtime efficiency.

records.title: Large Language Models for Cuffless Blood Pressure Measurement From Wearable Biosignals
records.reason: The paper adapts LLMs for wearable-biosignal blood-pressure estimation and evaluates prediction error; its contribution is application accuracy.

records.title: RetinaGS: Scalable Training for Dense Scene Rendering with Billion-Scale 3D Gaussians
records.reason: RetinaGS scales training of 3D Gaussian splatting for scene rendering; it is outside language-model inference/serving.

records.title: A Survey of Generative Techniques for Spatial-Temporal Data Mining
records.reason: This survey organizes generative approaches for spatial-temporal data mining; it is an application-domain taxonomy, not an LLM inference optimization.
